rule: Each slot must be executed in its own fresh regular non-project renderer conversation. Send only the exact packet text for that slot. Do not mention Kymaean, Ensemble, VFD-01, another slot, prior output, project history, evaluation criteria, or current-family material.
after_each: Preserve the original returned image bytes/provenance. Do not ask the renderer to explain, revise, regenerate, or produce an alternate.
batch_gate: Return all four untouched primary images to Design Sol before any evaluation or transfer execution. If a request returns no image because of a genuine technical failure, stop and report the failure; do not improvise a replacement prompt.
budget_before_execution: 0/6 judgeable images consumed; P1-P4 primary slots each available exactly once.
transfer_block: No transfer packet is executable until all four primary results are preserved and Design Sol has frozen the complete primary evaluation.
